title: krn lane run --ready --max N delivers ready tasks serially without a lead and stops on a repeated failure class
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114c #3. Pilots were driven by the untracked .krn/runs/pilot/lanes/run.sh; the lead wrote 23 of 49 PRs.
Outcome: krn lane run --ready --max N claims the next ready task, runs one lane, ships, and repeats; it stops after two consecutive failures of the same exit class and prints one summary line per task. It calls the credential preflight first when present.
Proof: tests with a stubbed session runner covering serial order, max, and stop-on-repeated-class; npm run fast PASS.
